name: ATA pulse-wave blaster
description: The ATA pulse-wave blaster was a vicious short-ranged plasma disruptor pistol capable of maiming or disintegrating targets. It was produced by Greff-Timms Industrial and was considered state-of-the-art millennia before the Galactic Civil War. The weapon functioned on the same basic principle as modern blasters during the war but fell under the auspices of disruptor weapon bans and control acts.
